content.json:
# Domain 4 Step 8 Tracing Showcase

This workbook packages the Step 8 App Insights demo queries for tracing capability. Use Q1 or Q3 to find a sample trace, then paste it into the **TraceId** parameter to drive Q2.

This workbook is intentionally tracing-demo oriented. It does not depend on troubleshooting-field normalization.

parameters.name: TraceId
parameters.description: Paste a trace_id from Q1 or Q3 to drive Q2.

content.json:
## Visual Overview
Open this section first if you want quick tracing graphics. Then use the tables below for drill-down.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true requests, dependencies, traces
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(operation_Id)
| summarize trace_count = dcount(operation_Id) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
| render timechart
content.title: Tracing Activity Trend (Last 24 Hours)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where cloud_RoleName == "AIGovernTrustworthyDemoAPIM"
| extend route = extract(
    "/(tier1|tier2|rag|native-model|finetune-model|vm-model|foundry-agent|copilot-studio)",
    0,
    tostring(url)
)
| where isnotempty(route)
| summarize calls = count() by route
| order by calls desc
| render barchart
content.title: APIM Route Volume (Last 24 Hours)

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where message in ("AIGovernTrustworthyLLMEvidence", "AIGovernTrustworthyVMModelTrace")
| extend target_type = coalesce(
    tostring(customDimensions["aigov.target.type"]),
    tostring(customDimensions["target_type"]),
    "unknown"
)
| summarize evidence_count = count() by target_type
| order by evidence_count desc
| render piechart
content.title: Evidence Coverage by Target Type (Last 7 Days)

content.json:
## Q1 - Recent Trace Overview
Shows recent trace groups across `requests`, `dependencies`, and `traces`. Use it to prove there are active traces and to find a sample `trace_id` for Q2.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true requests, dependencies, traces
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| extend trace_id = operation_Id
| where isnotempty(trace_id)
| summarize
    start_time = min(timestamp),
    end_time = max(timestamp),
    items_count = count(),
    services_involved = dcountif(cloud_RoleName, isnotempty(cloud_RoleName)),
    has_failure = maxif(1, success == false),
    sample_roles = make_set(cloud_RoleName, 5)
  by trace_id
| extend
    duration_ms = datetime_diff("millisecond", end_time, start_time),
    success_or_status = iff(has_failure == 1, "has_failure", "all_success_or_unknown")
| order by start_time desc
content.title: Q1 Recent Trace Overview

content.json:
## Q2 - Single Trace Chain Detail
Paste a value into **TraceId** above, then use this query to show the ordered call chain for one request.

content.query:
let trace_id = trim(" ", '{TraceId}');
union isfuzzy=true requests, dependencies, traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(trace_id)
| where operation_Id == trace_id
| project
    timestamp,
    trace_id = operation_Id,
    itemType,
    cloud_RoleName,
    name,
    message,
    id,
    operation_ParentId,
    resultCode,
    success,
    duration
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Q2 Single Trace Chain Detail

content.json:
## Q2a - Single Trace Sequence Graph
This is the minimum viable tracing call-chain graph in App Insights. It orders all rows for one `trace_id` by time and links each step to the next step.

content.query:
let trace_id = trim(" ", '{TraceId}');
let ordered = union isfuzzy=true requests, dependencies, traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(trace_id)
| where operation_Id == trace_id
| extend component_full = coalesce(cloud_RoleName, "unknown")
| extend component_short = case(
    component_full has "APIM", "APIM",
    component_full has "Tier1", "Tier1",
    component_full has "Tier2", "Tier2",
    component_full has "RAG", "RAG",
    component_full has "VMModel" or component_full has "VM", "VMModel",
    component_full has "shared_observability", "Evidence",
    substring(replace_string(replace_string(component_full, "AIGovernTrustworthyDemo.", ""), "AIGovernTrustworthy", ""), 0, 18)
)
| extend step_name = coalesce(name, message, itemType)
| extend step_short = case(
    step_name has "AIGovernTrustworthyLLMEvidence", "LLM Evidence",
    step_name has "AIGovernTrustworthyVMModelTrace", "VM Evidence",
    substring(step_name, 0, 36)
)
| extend duration_ms = iff(isnotempty(duration), tolong(duration), long(null))
| project timestamp, component_short, component_full, itemType, step_name, step_short, duration_ms, resultCode, success
| order by timestamp asc
| serialize step = row_number();
let nodes = ordered
| project
    nodeId = strcat("seq:", tostring(step)),
    nodeTitle = strcat(tostring(step), ". ", component_short),
    nodeSubtitle = strcat(itemType, " | ", step_short),
    nodeKind = itemType,
    duration_ms,
    edgeSourceId = "",
    edgeTargetId = "",
    edgeLabel = "",
    edgeWeight = long(null);
let links = ordered
| where step > 1
| project
    nodeId = "",
    nodeTitle = "",
    nodeSubtitle = "",
    nodeKind = "",
    duration_ms = long(null),
    edgeSourceId = strcat("seq:", tostring(step - 1)),
    edgeTargetId = strcat("seq:", tostring(step)),
    edgeLabel = strcat("step ", tostring(step)),
    edgeWeight = 1;
nodes
| union links
content.title: Q2a Single Trace Sequence Graph

content.json:
## Q2b - Single Trace Parent/Child Topology Graph
This is the stronger App Insights topology attempt. It uses `id` as the span node and `operation_ParentId` as the parent edge. If a parent span is missing from the query result, the node is attached to a synthetic trace root.

content.query:
let trace_id = trim(" ", '{TraceId}');
let raw = union isfuzzy=true requests, dependencies, traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(trace_id)
| where operation_Id == trace_id
| extend component_full = coalesce(cloud_RoleName, "unknown")
| extend component_short = case(
    component_full has "APIM", "APIM",
    component_full has "Tier1", "Tier1",
    component_full has "Tier2", "Tier2",
    component_full has "RAG", "RAG",
    component_full has "VMModel" or component_full has "VM", "VMModel",
    component_full has "shared_observability", "Evidence",
    substring(replace_string(replace_string(component_full, "AIGovernTrustworthyDemo.", ""), "AIGovernTrustworthy", ""), 0, 18)
)
| extend step_name = coalesce(name, message, itemType)
| extend step_short = case(
    step_name has "AIGovernTrustworthyLLMEvidence", "LLM Evidence",
    step_name has "AIGovernTrustworthyVMModelTrace", "VM Evidence",
    substring(step_name, 0, 36)
)
| extend raw_id = tostring(id)
| extend fallback_id = strcat(itemType, ":", tostring(hash(strcat(timestamp, component_full, step_name))))
| extend nodeId = iff(isempty(raw_id), fallback_id, raw_id)
| extend parentId = tostring(operation_ParentId)
| extend duration_ms = iff(isnotempty(duration), tolong(duration), long(null))
| project timestamp, nodeId, parentId, component_short, component_full, itemType, step_name, step_short, duration_ms, resultCode, success;
let span_ids = toscalar(raw | summarize make_set(nodeId));
let root = print trace_id = trace_id
| where isnotempty(trace_id)
| project
    nodeId = strcat("trace:", trace_id),
    nodeTitle = "Trace Root",
    nodeSubtitle = strcat(substring(trace_id, 0, 12), "..."),
    nodeKind = "trace",
    duration_ms = long(null),
    edgeSourceId = "",
    edgeTargetId = "",
    edgeLabel = "",
    edgeWeight = long(null);
let nodes = raw
| project
    nodeId,
    nodeTitle = component_short,
    nodeSubtitle = strcat(itemType, " | ", step_short),
    nodeKind = itemType,
    duration_ms,
    edgeSourceId = "",
    edgeTargetId = "",
    edgeLabel = "",
    edgeWeight = long(null);
let parent_edges = raw
| where isnotempty(parentId) and set_has_element(span_ids, parentId)
| extend targetNodeId = nodeId
| project
    nodeId = "",
    nodeTitle = "",
    nodeSubtitle = "",
    nodeKind = "",
    duration_ms = long(null),
    edgeSourceId = parentId,
    edgeTargetId = targetNodeId,
    edgeLabel = "parent",
    edgeWeight = 1;
let root_edges = raw
| where isempty(parentId) or not(set_has_element(span_ids, parentId))
| extend targetNodeId = nodeId
| project
    nodeId = "",
    nodeTitle = "",
    nodeSubtitle = "",
    nodeKind = "",
    duration_ms = long(null),
    edgeSourceId = strcat("trace:", trace_id),
    edgeTargetId = targetNodeId,
    edgeLabel = "root",
    edgeWeight = 1;
root
| union nodes
| union parent_edges
| union root_edges
content.title: Q2b Single Trace Parent/Child Topology Graph

content.json:
## Q3 - APIM Route-to-Backend Trace Proof
Summarizes traced calls by APIM route and returns a sample `trace_id` that can be copied into Q2.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where cloud_RoleName == "AIGovernTrustworthyDemoAPIM"
| extend route = extract(
    "/(tier1|tier2|rag|native-model|finetune-model|vm-model|foundry-agent|copilot-studio)",
    0,
    tostring(url)
)
| where isnotempty(route)
| summarize
    calls = count(),
    success_count = countif(success == true),
    avg_duration_ms = round(avg(duration), 0),
    p95_duration_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0),
    sample_trace_id = take_any(operation_Id)
  by route
| extend success_rate_pct = round(100.0 * success_count / calls, 1)
| project route, calls, success_rate_pct, avg_duration_ms, p95_duration_ms, sample_trace_id
| order by calls desc
content.title: Q3 APIM Route-to-Backend Trace Proof

content.json:
## Q4 - Evidence-Linked Trace Proof
Shows shared-observability evidence rows tied back to `trace_id`, `archive_id`, and `payload_ref`.

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where message == "AIGovernTrustworthyLLMEvidence"
| extend
    trace_id = operation_Id,
    service_name = tostring(customDimensions["service.name"]),
    source_type = tostring(customDimensions["aigov.source.type"]),
    target_type = tostring(customDimensions["aigov.target.type"]),
    target_id = tostring(customDimensions["aigov.target.id"]),
    response_id = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.id"]),
    archive_id = tostring(customDimensions["aigov.archive.id"]),
    payload_ref = tostring(customDimensions["aigov.payload.ref"]),
    status = tostring(customDimensions["status"])
| project
    timestamp,
    trace_id,
    service_name,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    response_id,
    archive_id,
    payload_ref,
    status
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Q4 Evidence-Linked Trace Proof

content.json:
## Q5 - Cross-Component Telemetry Coverage
The first query shows platform telemetry coverage by component. The second shows evidence-style events by target type.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true requests, dependencies, traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(cloud_RoleName)
| summarize
    requests_count = countif(itemType == "request"),
    dependencies_count = countif(itemType == "dependency"),
    traces_count = countif(itemType == "trace"),
    total = count(),
    latest_telemetry = max(timestamp)
  by cloud_RoleName
| order by total desc
content.title: Q5a Cross-Component Platform Telemetry Coverage

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where message in ("AIGovernTrustworthyLLMEvidence", "AIGovernTrustworthyVMModelTrace")
| extend target_type = coalesce(
    tostring(customDimensions["aigov.target.type"]),
    tostring(customDimensions["target_type"])
)
| summarize evidence_count = count(), latest = max(timestamp) by message, target_type
| order by evidence_count desc
content.title: Q5b Evidence Event Coverage
